name: sizhu-mcp-server
description: MCP server exposing the Sizhu middleware (Bazzi console) operations to an agent — a thin, auth-forwarding proxy over the Sizhu /api. Inherits the server-side default-deny + sensitive role+MFA guards; adds no privilege and holds no admin secret. NOTE: the money path (pod_dispatch) is OFF by default and the backend dispatch route does not yet enforce a server-side approval gate (see README C1) — required follow-up before real-payment autonomy.
